- `GET /chat/history`: Read the shared server-persisted chat thread (same for every browser). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /chat/history`: Append a chat turn to the shared thread (action=migrate imports a browser's old history once). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /tasks`: List tracked task records. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /tasks/delete`: Delete one tracked task record by id. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /tasks/clear`: Delete all tracked task records (undoable for a short window). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /tasks/clear/undo`: Restore the tasks wiped by a recent /tasks/clear (one-shot token). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /improve`: Create a self-improvement plan. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /improve/workflow`: Create a friendly self-improvement workflow. *(frontend: web panel `renderWorkflow`)*
- `POST /improve/preview`: Run a temporary self-improvement preview. *(frontend: web panel `renderWorkflow`)*
- `POST /improve/approve`: Approve a preview for code changes. *(frontend: web panel `renderWorkflow`)*
- `POST /learn`: Run a local feedback learning cycle. *(frontend: web panel `renderLearning`)*
- `POST /knowledge/teach`: Teach: persist a typed fact as durable recallable knowledge. *(frontend: web panel `renderLearning`)*
- `GET /knowledge`: List taught knowledge, optionally filtered by a query. *(frontend: web panel `renderLearning`)*
- `POST /knowledge/recall`: Recall taught knowledge matching a query. *(frontend: web panel `renderLearning`)*
- `GET /memory/personal/status`: Personal knowledge counts, categories, privacy classes and load state. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /memory/personal`: Search structured personal knowledge; query: `query`, `project`, `limit`, `include_*`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal`: Acquire one knowledge record with category, kind, source, privacy and validity. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /memory/personal/export`: Export the owner's personal knowledge and relationships as JSON. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/consolidate`: Consolidate equivalent records while preserving provenance and history. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/cleanup`: Apply retention/validity cleanup; expired records remain recoverable. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /memory/personal/{record_id}`: Inspect one knowledge record, its history, provenance and relations. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/{record_id}/correct`: Correct content while preserving the previous version in history. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/{record_id}/delete`: Delete one knowledge record and its relations from the shared store. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/{record_id}/resolve`: Resolve a detected contradiction by keeping or withdrawing one record. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /memory/personal/relations`: Create or update a provenance-bearing relationship between records. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /train`: Run bounded autonomous local learning iterations. *(frontend: web panel `renderLearning`)*
- `POST /brain/decide`: Trace an utterance through the routing gates with a rung preview. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /plan`: Create and optionally execute a plan. *(frontend: web panel `renderBuild`)*
- `POST /plan/run`: Run a goal through the agent loop; steps needing approval must be named. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /plan/code`: Plan a coding task: language-aware steps plus a drafted code artifact. *(frontend: web panel `renderBuild`)*
- `POST /build/save`: Save a drafted Build artifact to the build_workspace folder on disk. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /build/project`: Draft a small multi-file project with the coding agent: the configured model, or the sandbox-verified scaffold when none is installed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /build/artifacts`: Saved Build artifacts, newest first, for the Run list. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /build/run`: Re-execute a saved Build artifact in the sandbox. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /models/status`: What the shared model runtime holds right now, and the memory policy it applies to it. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/load`: Load a model, unloading whatever must go first to make room for it. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/unload`: Release one resident model, or every resident model when none is named. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /models/routing`: Phase 33 provider/model catalogue, health, routing controls and the last selection. *(frontend: web panel `renderModelRouting`)*
- `POST /models/routing/route`: Select the most appropriate model for a task, with eligible and rejected reasons. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/routing/complete`: Execute one routed completion through the selected adapter with bounded fallback. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/routing/config`: Set adaptive-routing cost, latency, concurrency and preference controls. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/routing/providers`: Enable or disable one provider for automatic selection. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /models/routing/history`: Recent routing decisions and measured provider/model observations. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /models/routing/policy`: The learned routing proposal, active policy and supporting evidence. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/routing/policy/activate`: Activate a validated learned routing policy (previous policy retained). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /models/routing/policy/rollback`: Roll back to the routing policy active before the last activation. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /command/plan`: Plan a natural desktop or phone command. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /command/execute`: Execute an approved natural desktop or phone command. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /desktop/plan`: Plan an approval-gated desktop action. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /desktop/execute`: Execute an approved desktop action. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /browser/plan`: Plan an approval-gated browser action (navigate, search + extract). *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /browser/execute`: Execute an approved browser action (search returns the top results). *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `GET /phone/status`: Inspect phone bridge status. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /phone/connect`: Run the phone bridge pairing flow. *(frontend: web panel `renderPhoneStatus`)*
- `GET /vision/status`: Vision capability report: model availability and open bug count. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /vision/model`: Install a multimodal vision model (ollama or a cloud provider) for element location. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /vision/model/clear`: Remove the configured vision model; element location returns to OCR-only. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /vision/describe`: Capture the screen and describe it (vision model or window probe). *(frontend: web panel `renderGeneric`)*
- `POST /vision/click`: Vision-locate a labeled element on screen, click it, and verify. *(frontend: web panel `renderGeneric`)*
- `GET /novaforge/status`: NovaForge readiness, saved mission draft and the active session. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/library`: Discovered games with installation evidence, launchability status and this process's own launch claim; query parameter: `q`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/library/resolve`: One game name's catalog status without launching anything; query parameter: `name`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/library/launch`: Preview a verified game launch and mint its approval token, or execute the plan that token approved (`name`/`command`, `approval_token`). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/library/close`: Close only the instance this process started (graceful window close) and confirm it exited. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/library/attach`: Report a game that was already running without taking ownership of it. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/windows`: Open windows for the NovaForge target picker, or why they cannot be read. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/mission`: Read the persisted NovaForge mission draft. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/mission`: Persist a NovaForge mission draft and report its field validation. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/validate`: Validate a mission and its live target window without starting a session. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions`: Stored NovaForge sessions, newest first. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions`: Start a validated NovaForge observation session. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}`: One NovaForge session: state, frames, observations and stages. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/pause`: Pause a running session and wait for the loop to acknowledge. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/resume`: Resume a paused session after re-validating its target window. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/stop`: Cancel a session, release input and persist its final record. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/cancel`: Abort the session loop now, release input and confirm the outcome (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/emergency-stop`: Guardian emergency stop: bounded abort, input cleanup and the confirmed result. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/capabilities`: Per-capability availability with the exact blocker: capture, action execution, Guardian enforcement, objective verification, persistence, decision pipeline, vision interpretation, game launch. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/trials`: Policy trial rows and aggregates from runs finished in this process; refused, failed and inconclusive trials are kept. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/observation`: The unified game observation pipeline: bound target, state, measured rate and latency, the last records, pause reason and bounded history. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/observation/start`: Bind one target window and start the bounded observation schedule; body: `title`, optional `game`, `pid`, `start_time`, `process`, `interval`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/observation/pause`: Pause a user-requested observation (never auto-cleared). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/observation/resume`: Resume a user pause after re-reading the pinned target identity. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/observation/stop`: Stop the observation schedule and clean up (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/observation/observe`: Capture and validate one frame now; a concurrent capture answers `busy` and starts nothing. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/observation/frame`: Serve the newest validated observation frame (PNG); 404 when nothing was validated. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/state`: The NF-16 game-state reader: last structured state, bounded history, profile table, measured processing latency, counts and refusals. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/state/analyze`: Read one game state from the newest VALIDATED observation; body may pin `profile_id`. A stale, missing or superseded observation is a refusal with a reason code. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/state/reset`: Forget the state comparison baseline (history is kept). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/state/profiles`: The perception profiles this build ships, including rejected ones and why. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/objectives`: The NF-17 objective picture: understood objectives, evidence, bounded history, diagnostics and measured interpretation latency. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/objectives/reset`: Forget the current objectives and the observation-ordering baseline; history and events are kept. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/objectives/profiles`: The objective rules this build ships, including rejected profiles and why. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/knowledge`: NF-18 game knowledge: per-game counts, revalidation due, the transient session memory and why it is not persisted; query parameter: `game`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/knowledge/records`: Knowledge records for ONE game with their evidence and status; query parameters: `game` (required), `category`, `status`, `q`, `limit`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/knowledge`: Record one explicit evidence-bearing knowledge candidate; an invalid category, content or evidence reference is a 422. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/knowledge/{knowledge_id}/revalidate`: Re-check one stale or contradicted record with fresh evidence; a record that needs no revalidation is reported, not changed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/objective`: Attach a checkable objective (window title) to a live session; unsupported kinds are recorded and reported unsupported. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/actions/plan`: Validate and digest-bind one gameplay action without sending it; a denial carries the Guardian's reason. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/actions/execute`: Execute one digest-bound action proposal after revalidating target identity, foreground, policy and budget. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/control`: NF-19 control-interface state: bounds, gate decision, held inputs, the last result and why nothing is running. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/control`: Run ONE typed, bounded input action (`kind` plus its parameters); a refusal is a 200 carrying its code, and completion never means the game reacted. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/control/cancel`: Ask the in-flight control action to stop at its next checkpoint and release what it holds. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/control/release`: Release every input the control interface holds (idempotent; refused while an action is in flight). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/plan`: NF-20 planning state: declared rules, the current plan, its candidates and rationale, bounds and the gate. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/plan`: Build ONE bounded plan from verified state, objective and knowledge; nothing is sent, and a missing or stale reading is a refusal with a code. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/plan/execute`: Execute ONE approved plan step by step through NF-19 (`plan_id`, `approved`, `approval_token` from the plan preview); 403 without the single-use token, stops on refusal, failure, staleness or objective change, and never claims an effect. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/plan/cancel`: Cancel the session's pending or running plan and its in-flight input operation (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/plan/replan`: Regenerate a stopped plan from fresh evidence within its bound (`plan_id`, `reason` from the declared triggers); the previous plan is invalidated first. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/outcomes`: NF-21 outcome verification state: declared rules, the last verification run, recorded outcomes, recovery counts and the policy's bounds. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/outcomes/verify`: Verify ONE plan's dispatched steps against fresh post-action observations (`plan_id`, `max_steps`); each step is verified_success, verified_failure, partial, unknown, timed out, aborted or not_verifiable, and missing evidence is never reported as a failure. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/outcomes/recover`: Carry out one outcome's recorded recovery decision (`outcome_id`, `approve`); side-effecting responses need explicit approval, unknown outcomes trigger a fresh bounded observation rather than a repeated action, and no recovery path dispatches input. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/outcomes/cancel`: Ask an in-flight outcome verification to stop at its next checkpoint (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy`: NF-22 autonomous run state: phase, outcome, pinned objective and completion criteria, current plan and plan-approval status, dispatched actions, last verification, recovery/replan counts, the declared budgets, the resource reading and the sessions a run may drive. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy/start`: Begin ONE bounded autonomous run over a live session (`approved`, `note`, `task`, `limits`); the operator's approval is the gate, every limit may be narrowed but never widened, and without approval the answer is `approval_required` with nothing started. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy/pause`: Pause an autonomous run (`reason`); the session pauses and the next cycle re-observes rather than continuing from a pre-pause reading. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy/resume`: Resume a paused autonomous run; a run that already ended is never restarted. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy/cancel`: Cancel an autonomous run before its next stage (`reason`) and let it end cleanly, releasing the session's input through the session's own stop path. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/autonomy/approve`: Answer a run parked in WAITING_FOR_APPROVAL (`approved`, `note`); one answer covers exactly one plan and the next plan parks again. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/autonomy/trace`: The complete autonomous orchestration history (query parameter: `session_id`): every phase move with its reason, observation and state references, objective readings, retrieved knowledge references, plans, approvals, execution results, verification evidence and recovery decisions. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/verify`: Run the independent objective verifier and record its verdict and evidence. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/loop`: Run the bounded closed loop once: observe, decide, plan, execute and verify through the session's own gates; query body: `max_actions`, `deadline_seconds`, `verify_first`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/loop/cancel`: Ask a running closed loop to stop before its next action (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/vision/interpret`: Describe the target's current frame with the configured vision model (read-only); returns the typed interpretation, its evidence references, latency and conflicts, or the exact reason no interpretation exists. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/verification`: The objective, its verdict, evidence references and action counts for one session. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/telemetry`: Measured telemetry and Guardian status for one session. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/timeline`: Read-only evidence timeline for one session (filterable, paged). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/sessions/{session_id}/timeline/{seq}`: One timeline event with its evidence resolved. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/timeline/compare`: Compare two persisted sessions from their recorded evidence; query: `left`, `right`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/frames/{session_id}`: Serve one captured frame (PNG); query parameter: `seq`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/scenarios`: Benchmark scenario catalog with supported/unsupported status, verifiers and metric definitions. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/scenarios/{scenario_id}`: One benchmark scenario's requirements and definitions; query parameter: `version`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/benchmarks/preflight`: Validate a benchmark scenario and its live target window without starting a run. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/runs`: Persisted benchmark runs, newest first; query parameters: `limit`, `scenario`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/benchmarks/runs`: Start one bounded benchmark observation run. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}`: One benchmark run: configuration, metrics, evidence and limitations. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}/cancel`: Cancel an active benchmark run through its session's stop path (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/compare`: Compare compatible benchmark runs from recorded results; query: `left`, `right`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/benchmarks/aggregate`: Per-scenario aggregate metrics for eligible runs; query: `scenario`, `version`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/games`: Game/environment compatibility registry with honest capability counts. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/games/{game_id}`: One environment's compatibility, capabilities and scenarios; query parameter: `version`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/evaluations`: Retained evaluation attempts, newest first; query parameters: `limit`, `game`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/evaluations/baseline`: Current baseline for an environment/scenario; query parameters: `game`, `scenario`, `version`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/evaluations/preflight`: Judge every readiness check against the live window without starting an evaluation. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/evaluations`: Start one confirmed evaluation: an observation run, or a controlled plan approved by the digest preflight issued. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/evaluations/{evaluation_id}`: One evaluation: readiness, benchmark run, baseline and status. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/evaluations/{evaluation_id}/cancel`: Cancel an active evaluation through its session's stop path (idempotent). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/evaluations/{evaluation_id}/report`: Per-game evaluation report with evidence links, missing evidence and limitations. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/coach`: Coach capability card: sources, classifications, experiment rules and honest limits. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/coach/analyse`: Evidence-backed analysis of one recorded session or evaluation (read-only; findings are recomputed). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/coach/recommendations`: Persisted recommendation statuses (operator decisions), newest first. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/coach/recommendations/{recommendation_id}`: Record an operator decision (proposed/approved/rejected/…) about one recommendation. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/experiments`: Retained controlled experiments, newest first; query parameters: `limit`, `status`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/experiments`: Propose an experiment from a recommendation or an explicit spec; starts nothing. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}`: One experiment: spec, approval, arms, results and history. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}/approve`: Approve the CURRENT configuration (its digest is bound to the approval). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}/reject`: Reject a proposal; the rejection is retained with its note. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}/run`: Run both arms through the evaluation lab (background, bounded, approval-checked). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}/cancel`: Cancel an experiment and its active arm (idempotent once terminal). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /novaforge/experiments/{experiment_id}/results`: The comparison and verdict, or an explicit not-available-yet answer. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /perception/status`: Perception layer report: providers, budgets, tracking and telemetry (no content). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /perception/capabilities`: Perception capability classification with live availability on this machine. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /perception`: Perceive an image, frame list, screen or camera into a structured scene (reading only - nothing is executed). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /world/status`: World model report: versions, entities, policies, retention and the honest prediction posture (no content). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /world/state`: Bounded, content-light view of the current world state (labels, statuses, boxes - no attribute values). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /world/observe`: Ingest one observation (or a batch) and advance the world state - recording only, nothing is executed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /world/query`: Answer a bounded structured question about current or historical world state, including evidence, uncertainty and staleness. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /world/predict`: Ask for a future state; reports model_unavailable when no predictive model is wired and never fabricates a prediction. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/status`: Interactive learning report: environments, policy and ceilings, learned rules, metrics and the honest provider posture. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/environments`: Every environment experiments may run in, with the actions each declares and whether it is a simulator. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/environments`: Register a deterministic SIMULATOR declared as data (rules, hidden actions, candidate outcomes, failures, delays, partial observations). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives`: Create a bounded learning objective (a question, an environment, ceilings). Creating one runs nothing. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/objectives`: The learning objectives this session holds, and which are open. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/objectives/{objective_id}`: One objective: cycle steps, hypotheses with their evidence, experiments with their statuses, runs, evidence references and rules. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/preview`: Ranked candidate experiments for an objective, with the reason each other candidate was refused. Nothing is executed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/run`: Run the bounded learning cycle: observe, hypothesize, select, gate, act, compare, update. Refused and interrupted experiments are never reported as successes. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/approve`: Approve ONE real (non-simulator) experiment. The approval is single use. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/reject`: Refuse an objective; the refusal becomes the recorded reason it stopped. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/cancel`: Ask the objective's cycle to stop at its next checkpoint. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/resumable`: Whether an interrupted objective may be resumed, and why not when it may not. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/objectives/{objective_id}/resume`: Re-run an interrupted objective when the safety preconditions can be verified; otherwise it stays interrupted. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/metrics`: Learning metrics: hypotheses moved, agreement over evaluable predictions, duplicates avoided, refusals and costs. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /learning/evidence/{evidence_id}`: One evidence reference and the experiment behind it - the provenance door for tracing a conclusion. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /learning/transfer`: Check a learned rule against cases the caller held out, with the limits of that check stated plainly. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /planning/status`: Goal-planning report: goals, planned and verified counts, replan budgets, the boot restore report and the capability table with live availability (including the honest provider posture). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /planning/goals`: Every goal this session holds, and which have a selected plan. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /planning/goals`: Record a goal, decompose it into validated tasks and produce CANDIDATE plans with their comparison and the selected one. Runs nothing. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /planning/goals/{goal_id}`: One goal: decomposition issues, candidate plans, the selected plan, the last run's revalidations and completion verdict. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /planning/goals/{goal_id}/run`: Execute the selected plan through the existing executor, re-checking each step's preconditions against fresh state and verifying the goal's success conditions before reporting completion. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /planning/goals/{goal_id}/reassess`: Whether a goal should be replanned, the deviations seen and whether its replan ceiling is exhausted. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /planning/goals/{goal_id}/cancel`: Cancel a goal. Cancelling is not deleting: the record stays readable. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /embodied/status`: Embodied sessions: allowlisted environments with live availability, scenarios, session counts, ceilings, the input door's scope and the capability table with the honest absences. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /embodied/overview`: What Phase 25 ships and what it refuses to claim: the loop, the lifecycle vocabularies, the scenarios, the event types and the honesty flags. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /embodied/environments`: The environments this build may drive, with their status and the capabilities each declares as verified or merely declared. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /embodied/sessions`: Every embodied session this process holds, with its lifecycle state. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /embodied/sessions`: Record a session from an objective and its environments. Runs nothing: creating is not starting. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /embodied/sessions/{session_id}`: One session: objective, status and reason, the completion verdict with the conditions observed and missing, the bounded trajectory and the evaluation. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /embodied/sessions/{session_id}/run`: Drive the bounded loop: observe, decide through the goal planner, send ONE authorized input, verify it from a fresh reading, then recover or replan and report the ending. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /embodied/sessions/{session_id}/pause`: Pause a session; what it holds is released before the status moves. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /embodied/sessions/{session_id}/resume`: Resume a paused session, which returns it as needing revalidation before any further input. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /embodied/sessions/{session_id}/cancel`: Cancel a session and release what it holds. Cancelling is not deleting: the record stays readable. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/status`: What this build can measure about its own generalization: corpus and split counts with the leakage verdict, families with their verifiers, solvers, baselines, operators, search ceilings, run counters, provider posture and the capability table. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/overview`: What Phase 26 ships and refuses to claim: the evaluation cycle, the lifecycle vocabularies, the families, the operator library, the verifiers, the failure categories and the honesty flags. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/families`: The task families, each with its own success condition and verifier. No aggregate score: the families are measured in different units. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/operators`: The bounded grid transformation library the search may use, with its composition depth ceiling and the rule families it covers. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/tasks`: The registered tasks matching a filter, WITHOUT their answer keys. Query parameters: `family`, `split`, `difficulty`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/tasks/{task_id}`: One task whole: request, success condition, verifier, split, examples and the expected output the evaluator holds. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/splits`: How the corpus is split, with the three-way leakage verdict: overlapping ids, shared answers and examples already used while tuning. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /generalization/tasks`: Register one task on this process's corpus. Runs nothing: a task is a definition with a success condition and an answer key, not an evaluation. 422 when the task is unverifiable or its id is taken. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /generalization/evaluate`: Run one bounded evaluation over the same tasks for candidate and baseline, and return the run with its per-family metrics, classified failures, frozen settings and outcome fingerprint. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/runs`: The stored runs as trimmed rows: lifecycle fields and counts only, never the per-task result bodies. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/runs/{run_id}`: One run whole: settings, seed, per-family metrics, classified failures with evidence, recommendations and the per-task results. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/runs/{run_id}/export`: A review payload: the run, the corpus and splits, the operator library, the reproduce block and the outcome fingerprint. Schedules nothing and promotes nothing. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/compare`: Two stored runs compared task by task, with neither record modified. Query parameters: `baseline`, `candidate`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/failures`: Classified failures grouped by category. Query parameter: `run` (one run, or every stored run without it). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/recommendations`: Structured, non-executing improvement recommendations from real failures. Query parameter: `run`. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/game-eval/contracts`: The nine evaluation contracts the post-Phase-26 game milestone will be measured on. Definitions and sources, not a game. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /generalization/game-eval`: Those contracts measured over the embodied sessions this build actually ran, per environment, with unmeasured figures as null. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /intelligence`: Global Intelligence Layer: telemetry, findings, and capabilities. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /capabilities`: Every capability this installation has (declared, tool, action), with its availability, risk, permissions, tools, inputs and outputs. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /capabilities/discover`: What capabilities are available for this task? Query parameters: `query` (required), `intent`, `category`, `tools`, `models`, `include_unavailable`, `limit`. Discovery only - nothing runs. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /bugs`: List recorded bugs (what failed, where, and when). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /bugs/{bug_id}/fix`: Mark a recorded bug as fixed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /bugs/clear-fixed`: Remove all bugs already marked fixed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /phone/plan`: Plan an approval-gated phone action. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /phone/execute`: Execute an approved phone action. *(frontend: web panel `renderCommand`)*
- `POST /agent/run`: Run the full agentic loop for a natural-language goal. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /agent/metrics`: Agentic evaluation metrics (success, recovery, verification rates). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /agent/knowledge`: Application knowledge graph: workflows, confidence, freshness. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /explore`: Research a topic and return an Explore report. *(frontend: web panel `renderExplore`)*
- `GET /explore/trending`: Current daily research topics from live top-story news (rotating window). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /activity`: Recent completed actions (commands, research, learning) for the web timeline. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /events/stream`: Live activity channel: the application EventBus as SSE. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /settings`: Read local user settings. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /settings`: Update local user settings. *(frontend: web panel `renderSettingsResult`)*
- `GET /plugins`: List plugin API records. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /automation`: Scheduled automations: what is stored, armed, and due next. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/schedule`: Store a request plus the schedule it states as an automation (nothing runs yet). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/approve`: Authorize a pending automation so it may be armed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/cancel`: Cancel an automation so it never runs again. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/enable`: Arm an approved automation again. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/disable`: Disarm an automation without cancelling it. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/run`: Run a stored automation now, under the same permission gate as a due run. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /automation/run-due`: Run every automation that is due (the scheduler's own tick). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /operations`: Persistent operations board: objectives, task counts, monitoring conclusions and notification posture. *(frontend: web panel `renderOperations`)*
- `GET /objectives`: Every stored objective with its milestones, tasks, progress and checkpoints. *(frontend: web panel `renderOperations`)*
- `POST /objectives`: Create an ongoing objective with an intended outcome and autonomy level. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/update`: Edit an objective's title, outcome, priority, deadline, autonomy or criteria. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/delete`: Delete one objective and its stored work. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/control`: Pause, resume, cancel, prioritize, re-deadline or re-level an objective. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/tasks`: Add a task (with dependencies, steps, due time or recurrence) to an objective. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/milestones`: Add a milestone over a set of tasks. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/run`: Run the ready work of one objective under its autonomy and the permission layer. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /objectives/tasks/decide`: Approve, reject, retry or cancel one objective task. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /operations/notifications`: Stored operations notifications, newest first, with preferences. *(frontend: web panel `renderOperations`)*
- `POST /operations/notifications/read`: Acknowledge one notification, or all of them. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /operations/notifications/clear`: Delete stored notifications. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /operations/notifications/preferences`: Choose which notification kinds are delivered and how long duplicates are suppressed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /operations/tick`: Run one monitoring/execution pass (the background loop's body). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /audit`: Operational audit trail status: records, retention, local-only storage, redactions. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /audit/entries`: Recent audit records (redacted), oldest first. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /audit/prune`: Apply the retention policy and report what was removed. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /audit/delete`: Delete one audit record by id. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /audit/clear`: Delete every audit record (explicit, not retention). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /privacy`: Execution mode, privacy controls and every outbound decision. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /privacy`: Change the execution mode and/or a privacy control, live. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /resources`: The resource governor's reading of this machine, with its reasons. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /cost/estimate`: Estimate a request's cost and routing hint (never a gate). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /diagnostics`: Run the component roster, or a comma-separated subset via ?only=. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /benchmark`: Stored model measurements and the measured comparison per category. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /benchmark`: Measure a model on the given tasks through the live provider. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /evaluation/summary`: Recorded trajectories, quality verdicts, scores and retention, at a glance. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /evaluation/trajectory/{trajectory_id}`: One stored trajectory with its evaluation and reward breakdown. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /evaluation/metrics`: Aggregate metrics over stored trajectories (success, latency p50/p95, reward, routing). *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /evaluation/rewards`: Stored rewards, newest first, with their component and penalty breakdowns. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /training/status`: Training subsystem state: enabled, dry-run, backend, capabilities. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `GET /training/summary`: Datasets, runs, checkpoints and models, at a glance. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*
- `POST /training/estimate`: Estimate a training config's resources without starting anything. *(frontend: no web panel - API/CLI or infrastructure)*

## WebSocket Routes

- `WS /ws/events`: event channel with ping/pong and echo behavior

## Authentication

Set `NOVACONTROL_API_TOKEN` to require bearer-token authentication for protected routes.

```powershell
$env:NOVACONTROL_API_TOKEN='change-me'
python -m uvicorn novacontrol.api.app:create_app --factory --reload
```

Example protected request:

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod `
  -Method Post `
  -Uri http://127.0.0.1:8000/plan `
  -Headers @{ Authorization = 'Bearer change-me' } `
  -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body '{"goal":"research options then implement one","execute":true}'
```

## CLI

```powershell
python -m novacontrol demo phase12
```
